title: Store Receiving Standard: Receipt Inspection and Customer Damage Claims for Ridgeline Special Order Services
content:
**1. Store receipt.** Where the program requires a receipt inspection, the store inspects a Ridgeline Special Order Services item within the program's receipt inspection period, in days of arrival, and makes it ready only when the condition is good; an item found damaged or wrong at store receipt is reordered from the vendor at no charge and the estimated ready date is revised.

**2. Damage found by the customer.** Shipping damage found by the customer is covered only when it is reported within the program's damage report period, in hours after pickup or delivery, recorded as a condition record at the customer handover.

**3. Counting the hours.** Hours are counted as full 60-minute periods from the start of the completed date (00:00 store local time) to the report; a report at exactly that many hours qualifies.

**4. Remedies for covered damage.** For covered damage the customer chooses one remedy: a free reorder where the program reorders free, with a new promised ready date the program's replacement lead time in days after the report; or, for cosmetic damage only and where the program's damage allowance percentage is above 0, keeping the item with an allowance.

*Retired clause.* The clause that fixed that allowance as "keeping the item with an allowance of the damage allowance percentage of the order total as a damage allowance credit" is **no longer in force**; the allowance on that remedy is set by the current damage allowance basis.

**5. Not covered.** Damage reported later, or caused after handover, is not covered.

## Evidence and time gate

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | pickup or delivery, shown as the completed date on the special order record |
| Report time | the moment the customer's damage claim on that order was registered |
| Authority | the order and claim records, read before any allowance is credited; the customer's account of when the damage was noticed is not the record |
| Comparison | the report is not later than the damage report period |
| Boundary | a report at exactly the period qualifies |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical completed date 4 May)

| Program period | Claim registered | Full hours from 4 May 00:00 | Covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| 48 hours | 6 May at 00:00 | 48 | yes |
| 48 hours | 6 May at 01:00 | 49 | no |
| 72 hours | 7 May at 00:00 | 72 | yes |
| 72 hours | 7 May at 01:00 | 73 | no |

## Points of judgement

- The hours start at midnight at the start of the completed date, whatever the time of the pickup or delivery.
- For functional damage or a wrong item, the keep-with-allowance remedy is not open: it is for cosmetic damage only.
- A program whose damage allowance percentage is 0 offers no keep-with-allowance remedy.
